**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post's claim that police kill innocent Black people and escape consequences closely matches T4-002635, which frames each incident as "another cop. Another black man. Another killing of innocent person" [T4-002635](#T4-002635), and T4-009301, which asks why "#cops are allowed to get away with murder?!" under #PoliceBrutality [T4-009301](#T4-009301). T4-009367 shares the impunity narrative, saying police "have committed more crimes than black people or anybody lately. Yet there's no justice" with #BlackSkinIsNotACrime [T4-009367](#T4-009367). Differences are notable: T4-003352 attacks police competence and legal authority generally without mentioning race or killings [T4-003352](#T4-003352), while T4-003800 calls for one officer's arrest but adds that "fellow blacks are the worse enemy," a target absent from the new post [T4-003800](#T4-003800). All appear to be endorsements of police misconduct rather than rebuttals or reporting, though none supplies evidence beyond its own assertion.
